title: Nursery Rhyme Song
transcription:
Nursery Rhyme Song

Chorus:
They bonged it out the window,
The second story window,
High low, low high,
They bonged it out the window

Nursery rhymes as the verses, two teams can
compete to see who can come up with the most
nursery rhymes. Everyone joins in on chorus.
